The drive home is straightforward, and CA smog registration is feasible for a 2017 50-state vehicle.

positives: Photos show a refresh-generation GX460 with clean paint, an intact black leather interior, a sunroof, 2nd-row captain's chairs and a folded 3rd row giving a flat cargo floor, useful for a sleeping platform.
Roof crossbars/rack and a receiver hitch are fitted (photo), relevant to the rooftop-tent intent.
Deep-tread all-terrain tires on aftermarket wheels are visible, with no obvious heavy off-road hardware or big lift in the photos.
The seller offers 'full maintenance records' and yearly Krown undercoating since 2020. If receipts exist, these would materially strengthen the case.
The 1UR-FE V8 is timing-chain driven with no belt interval, and the platform has a strong reliability reputation.
concerns: Observed: Ohio car whose yearly Krown treatment confirms winter salt exposure, and frame rust is the GX weak point on non-western cars. No underside photos examined here (inspect frame rails, rear crossmember, brake/fuel lines on a lift).
Observed: Asking price is above the fair-value range for mileage-adjusted sold comps, with no VIN or records yet offered to justify a premium.
Observed: Aftermarket wheels and all-terrain tires of unknown size, plus RAM mounts on the dash. The tire size, any lift or leveling, and any drilled trim should be confirmed.
Unverified: 'Full maintenance records' and 'maintenance all up to date' are claims only (ask for scans, especially transmission, transfer case, differentials, coolant and ~120k spark plugs).
Unverified: Secondary air injection (P2440/P2442) and KDSS leak/lean status (ask for invoices; scan and inspect at PPI).
Unverified: Valley-plate coolant leak, timing-cover seepage and transfer-case actuator health, plus towing history given the fitted hitch (ask and inspect).

seller_questions: Can you send the VIN so I can run a Carfax/AutoCheck and request Lexus dealer service history?
Can you send scans or photos of the full maintenance records, specifically the dates and mileages for transmission, transfer case and differential fluids, coolant, and spark plugs?
Has the car ever shown P2440 or P2442 codes, or had the secondary air injection pump or valves replaced? If so, can you send the invoice?
Has the KDSS system ever leaked, been serviced, or shown any lean? Can you photograph the front and rear KDSS cylinders?
Can you send the Krown receipts for each year, plus recent photos of the frame rails, rear crossmember and spare-tire area, ideally after a wash?
What brand and size are the tires, what are their DOT date codes, and has any lift, leveling kit or suspension change been fitted?
Can you send a cold-start video (engine sat overnight, hood open) and a photo of the instrument cluster with the engine running?
Will you allow an independent pre-purchase inspection at a Cleveland-area Lexus dealer or independent shop, including time on a lift, before any deposit?
How long have you owned it, and did you buy it from Metro Lexus? How many owners before you?
What has the hitch been used for: what trailer weight, and how often?
Has any shop noted coolant seepage at the rear of the engine (valley plate) or at the timing cover?
Is the title in your name and free of any lien?
ppi_focus: Frame and underbody on a lift: rails, rear crossmember, spare-tire carrier, body mounts, brake and fuel lines. Probe through the Krown film for scale or perforation.
KDSS cylinders, accumulator and lines for weeping; measure ride height side to side for lean.
Full-module OBD scan including stored/pending/history codes, with specific attention to P2440/P2442 and SAI pump operation.
Rear of the 1UR-FE and bellhousing seam for pink coolant crust (valley plate); timing cover seepage.
Transfer case: 4LO engagement, center-diff lock, actuator function, and fluid condition.
Rear air height-control suspension, control-arm bushings, shocks and steering rack for wear.
Tire size, fitment, rubbing at full lock and articulation; DOT dates; alignment; check for any lift components.
Transmission fluid condition and rear brake/hitch wiring wear as towing indicators.
Roof rack mounting points and sunroof drains for leaks; headliner staining.
Dash trim around the RAM mounts for drilled holes.
what_would_change_verdict: A VIN producing a clean history report, plus actual maintenance invoices covering fluids and SAI/KDSS, would substantially raise documentation.
A clean PPI on a lift showing only surface rust, with no KDSS leaks, no SAI codes and no valley-plate seepage, would move condition up.
A negotiated price inside the fair-value range would lift price value.
Evidence of frame scale or perforation, an active KDSS leak, SAI codes, or seller refusal of a VIN or PPI would move it sharply down.
evidence.mission_note: A GX460 delivers capability the RX 350 does not: body-on-frame, low-range 4WD, a roof rack for a rooftop tent, and a flat folded cargo floor for a sleeping platform, so it fits the utility branch on paper. Its salt-belt history and undocumented condition are the open questions, and nothing about the urgency mode justifies skipping a PPI.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes, via photos, a silver refresh-generation GX460 with automatic, sunroof, 2nd-row captain's chairs, roof rack, hitch, and aftermarket wheels on deep-tread all-terrain tires, in visually clean cosmetic condition. Year, trim, 128,500 miles, clean title and accident-free status are seller claims, with no VIN to verify them. The seller claims 'full maintenance records' and yearly Krown undercoating since 2020, but neither is shown; the Krown claim itself confirms Ohio winter salt exposure, making frame rust the central open question. None of the model-critical items (secondary air injection, KDSS, frame condition, warning lights) is evidenced beyond seller prose. Nothing is observed wrong beyond normal driver-seat and steering-wheel wear, and there are no underside photos to examine. The $23,900 asking price sits above the mileage-adjusted fair-value range and has not moved during a long listing period. Distance to Carmel is a logistics and cost matter, and PPI access has not yet been established.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller asking for the VIN, scans of the maintenance and Krown records, and recent frame photos, and ask for written confirmation that a lift-based PPI at a Cleveland-area shop is allowed before any deposit.
